_comment: Prune list for vcdj_ctrlsw.c/.h, applied by vcdj_ctrlsw_prune.py after vcdj_ctrlsw_gen.py. Rules locate code by name and structure, never by line number, so regenerating or regrouping the output does not invalidate them. Class letters refer to the list in ip-validation-notes/vcdj/plans/ctrlsw-merge.md 3.4.1.
